name: ATI Clean Energy Incubator at the University of Texas at Austin

description.text: Founded in 2001, the ATI Clean Energy Incubator (CEI) is one of the longest-established energy and clean-tech incubators in the United States. Our parent institution, The University of Texas, does more energy research than any other university in the world. To date we’ve worked with companies in a variety of areas including energy efficiency, renewables, grid modernization and optimization, batteries and storage, demand response, and distributed generation.
